Activist Announces New Protest Date and Location

Activist Abhijit Dipke has announced a new date and location for a gathering. The protest will not take place at Jantar Mantar this time, but in a different area of Delhi. The Lallantop reported that Dipke informed people of the new date and place. Dainik Jagran referred to the participants as 'cockroaches' and stated they would gather in a specific Delhi locality.
